final: WITH patient_groups AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB) AS avg_albumin, AVG(1.0 * l.UN / l.`T-BIL`) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_groups AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_albumin) AS A, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_groups GROUP BY SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(A) AS B FROM sex_groups) SELECT s.SEX, s.A, s.avg_ratio, s.A - o.B FROM sex_groups AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.B IS NOT NULL AND s.A > o.B
